surface_mechanism_description: The ALD of Cu with methanol and ethanol involves two reaction steps: first, the adsorption of the reducing agent (ROH) to form surface radicals (R·(ad) and OH·(ad)), followed by the reaction of the Cu(hfac)2·XH2O with H2 and surface radicals to produce Cu, RH, (CF3)2CH·, and (COOH)2.
evidence: The following reaction steps are proposed for ALD of Cu with methanol and ethanol. First reaction step ROH j R·(ad) + OH·(ad) (R for alkyl group). Second reaction step Cu(hfac)2·XH2O + H2 + R·(ad) + OH·(ad) j Cu + RH + (CF3)2CH· + (COOH)2.
